_about: Control variant: the notebook's harness and prompts exactly as built, no extra turn instructions, no flag changes. Copy this file to make a variant: 'instructions' is added to every turn message where the built-in modes put theirs; 'env' overrides harness flags (any ARC3_* / LOCAL_ANALYZER_* / MULTIMODAL_* key the notebook sets); 'settings' overrides the Stock sampling settings (temperature, thinking, effort, thinking_budget, tool_calls, actions).
name: stock
